decisive_finding.cause: CacheSnapshot discards plugin_id, version, marketplace, and cache_root_id after reconciling caller-authored expectations; from_verified_cache then compares only context, candidate, and tree identity.
decisive_finding.reproduction: A version 0.0.11 package accepted an exact version 9.9.9 cache observation with matching context, candidate, and tree and promoted it into a journey-bound Cache SurfaceIdentity.
decisive_finding.impact: A caller-selected wrong-version or wrong-root cache observation can be laundered into a package- and journey-bound identity.

verified_non_issue: The corrected marketplace snapshot retains plugin_id and version and rejected the corresponding 9.9.9 marketplace substitution.
smallest_safe_correction: Retain canonical plugin_id and version in CacheSnapshot and compare them with PackageIdentity::source before promotion.
Retain cache_root_id and compare it with JourneyBinding::home_id before promotion.
Add locked and offline same-tree wrong-version and wrong-root controls and repeat the full independent package review.
claim_ceiling: The source-local package identity candidate remains REWORK; only artifact reconciliation and the marketplace-version guard were established.
no_claim_statement: This review does not claim package identity acceptance, installation, cache, marketplace, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
